# MonlooQ

> MonlooQ is a free fashion app for iPhone and Android that combines an AI stylist (Maya AI), virtual try-on on your own photo, a digital closet, and a fashion community.

MonlooQ (also written Monlooq) turns a phone into a personal styling assistant, a digital wardrobe and a social fashion network in one app. It is free to download, rated 13+, and available in English.

## Features

- Maya AI stylist: chat for outfit ideas, fit, colour and fabric advice, occasion planning and capsule wardrobes; can suggest looks built from the user's own closet.
- Image mode: generate outfit images from a description, edit a photo, restyle a look.
- Virtual try-on ("Try it on me"): place a garment or full look on the user's own photo while preserving their face, proportions and pose.
- Digital closet: save, browse and search a wardrobe; multi-select pieces to plan outfits; save favourites and past looks.
- Discover: Looks, People, Communities and Hashtags; join communities around styles and trends; follow accounts.
- Reels: a vertical feed of fashion videos, styling tips and community content.
- Messages: direct messaging with photos, links, files and disappearing messages.
- Privacy and safety: profile visibility controls, notification preferences, block and report, in-app safety tips.
- Light and dark mode.
